sources.title: Cross-Modal Attention Fusion: A Deep Learning and Affective Computing ...
sources.snippet: However, as recently noted by Mengara Mengara and Moon [88], “multimodal emotion recognition faces substantial challenges due to the inherent heterogeneity of data sources, each with its own temporal resolution, noise characteristics, and potential for incompleteness” [88] (p. 1). In this context, this article put forward and evaluated a novel audio-image-based cross-modal fusion model which leverages a Tucker decomposition-based factorization layer designed to explicitly capture and efficiently fuse high-order spatiotemporal feature interactions.
